pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Tidio's pricing page lists five plans: Free, Starter ($29/mo), Growth ($59/mo), Plus ($749/mo), and Premium (contact sales)… The Free plan offers 50 conversations… plus a one-time 50 Lyro conversations… The Lyro AI Agent add-on starts at $39 per month"

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: 50 conversations per month, one-time 50 Lyro AI conversations

nl.tagline: Livechat en AI-chatbot Lyro voor webshops en mkb
nl.description: Tidio biedt livechat, e-mail en social in één inbox, plus de AI-agent Lyro die veelgestelde vragen beantwoordt op basis van je eigen informatie. Populair bij webshops. Let op: gesprekken, AI-gesprekken en flows worden apart afgerekend.
bestFor: Webshops die snel een chatbot willen
Kleine teams met één gedeelde inbox
notFor: Wie één voorspelbare all-in prijs zoekt
limitations: Drie aparte verbruiksmeters maken de totaalprijs lastig voorspelbaar

en.tagline: Live chat and the Lyro AI chatbot for stores and SMBs
en.description: Tidio offers live chat, email and social in one inbox, plus Lyro, an AI agent that answers common questions from your own content. Popular with online stores. Note: conversations, AI conversations and flows are billed separately.
bestFor: Small teams with one shared inbox
notFor: People wanting one predictable all-in price
limitations: Three separate usage meters make total cost hard to predict
